item.title: Mamdani defends secret meeting with Trump, pitch to build 12,000 housing units
item.description: Mamdani said that he chose to focus on housing in his conversations with Trump both because it's "the foremost crisis in New York City" and because it's an area of interest "across the political spectrum."

item.title: Mary Cosby to continue ‘RHOSLC’ Season 7 after son’s unexpected death
item.description: Mary Cosby will reportedly continue with the upcoming season of “The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City” following the sudden death of her son, Robert Cosby Jr. Although there was speculation she might take step away for Season 7, sources close to the production told TMZ on Friday that she has chosen to continue filming. item.title: With only 3 women left, an Amazon tribe faced extinction. An unexpected birth now brings hope
item.description: Three women lived for years as the last members of the Akuntsu people.

item.title: Pink in consideration to take over Kelly Clarkson’s talk show slot at NBC
item.description: Pink is reportedly being eyed to take over Kelly Clarkson's talk show slot at NBC, as the latter prepares to leave the network this fall.

item.title: Cops identify 3 New Jersey women in Wendy’s drive-thru rampage caught on video
item.description: New Jersey police have identified the three women involved in a wild fight with Wendy's drive-thru staffers in Ewing Township last week, video of which went viral online.

item.title: Woman, 51, found dead in Bronx apartment
item.description: Responding officers found the 51-year-old victim's lifeless body inside an apartment on Grand Ave. near Macombs Road in Morris Heights after her daughter called 911 at 12:18 p.m., police said.

item.title: Josh Minott flashes vs. former team, but Celtics’ 3-point barrage buries Nets in 37-point loss
item.description: Brooklyn fell to the Boston Celtics 148-111 at TD Garden, dropping to 15-44 and tying its longest losing streak of the season at seven games.

item.title: Knicks rout Bucks behind Jalen Brunson’s 22-point 1st quarter
item.description: The Knicks' captain scored 22 points in the opening period and finished the night with 27 points on 11-of-17 shooting from the field.
